name: Balewadi
civicNote: Brought into PMC limits in 1997 along with 22 other villages.
summary: A residential suburb in Pune's western corridor, next to Baner and Aundh, that grew from a fringe village after joining PMC in 1997.
knownFor: Shree Shiv Chhatrapati Sports Complex, venue of the 1994 National Games
Office parks shared with neighbouring Baner
connectivity: Baner Road links Balewadi to central Pune
Katraj-Dehu Road bypass corridor passes the area
Pune Metro Line 3: Balewadi Stadium and NICMAR open since 4 November 2026; Balewadi Phata later
suits: Professionals working in Baner, Balewadi or Hinjewadi who want a newer residential area close to the western IT belt.
